name: code-quality
description: Code quality analysis on tree-sitter syntax trees (JS/TS/TSX, Python, Go, Java, Rust, C#): cyclomatic/cognitive complexity, Halstead and maintainability, code smells, token clone detection, resolved import graph with cycles and architecture boundary rules, dead code (unused files/exports/dependencies), the project's own linters and type-checkers (ESLint, Biome, Prettier, tsc, Ruff, Pylint, mypy, pyright, golangci-lint, Clippy, Checkstyle, PMD, dotnet format) with SARIF output, coverage ingestion (LCOV/Cobertura/JaCoCo) with CRAP risk ranking, diff-only analysis against a git ref, and a baseline quality gate
shortDescription: Complexity, smells, clones, dead code, import graph, linters, coverage, quality gate

envVars.name: CHECKSTYLE_JAR
envVars.description: Optional path to a Checkstyle all-in-one jar, run with java -jar when no checkstyle executable is on PATH
